questions.q: How many word classes (Shabad Shrenian) are there in Punjabi grammar?
questions.qPa: ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਵਿਆਕਰਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਸ਼੍ਰੇਣੀਆਂ ਕਿੰਨੀਆਂ ਹਨ?
questions.explanation: There are 8 word classes (Noun, Pronoun, Adjective, Verb, Adverb, Preposition, Conjunction, Interjection).
'ਇੱਜੜ' represents a group, so it is an Ikath-vachak Naav (Collective Noun).

questions.q: How many types of Nouns (Naav) are there?
How many types of Pronouns (Parnaav) are there?
Identify the type of pronoun: 'ਆਪ' (in 'ਉਹ ਆਪ ਗਿਆ').
questions.qPa: 'ਉਹ ਆਪ ਗਿਆ' ਵਿੱਚ 'ਆਪ' ਕਿਹੜਾ ਪੜਨਾਂਵ ਹੈ?

questions.q: How many types of Adjectives (Visheshan) are there?
In the sentence 'ਇਹ ਕਿਤਾਬ ਮੇਰੀ ਹੈ', what is 'ਇਹ'?
questions.qPa: ਵਾਕ 'ਇਹ ਕਿਤਾਬ ਮੇਰੀ ਹੈ' ਵਿੱਚ 'ਇਹ' ਕੀ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: Since 'ਇਹ' is modifying the noun 'ਕਿਤਾਬ', it acts as a Nishche-vachak Visheshan (Demonstrative Adjective).
'ਸੋਨਾ' is a material that can be weighed, so it is Vastu-vachak Naav.
